# CBDB-Desktop: Places (Look At Place) label revisions, 2026-10-28

Ninth form in the review of HTML labels against the MS Access FormLabels table (form code LAP, 34 rows in the updated 643-row table). Changes are in the Places form's index.html and in the shared cbdb_styles.css (CSS-3); no back-end change was needed. The page script was syntax-checked, and the page was loaded in a scripted browser (jsdom) with the stylesheet: all 36 labels and placeholders written by setLanguage were compared with their translations in all three languages, and PLC-7, PLC-8 and CSS-3 were checked, with no script errors. **Not yet tested in the running app**; spacing and fit are still to be checked. A copy of the file before these changes was kept as index.before-labels.html. PLC-1 to PLC-6 are in the reports of 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-15. Revised later the same day: four relation-category labels keep the HTML's English, with new Chinese (LBL-102).

## How to revert a label

All labels are in the translations object near the top of the script, under english, traditional and simplified. Change the value of the key in the **Key** column, in the language concerned. Each line has a comment naming its FormLabels row (or "No row") and, where changed, the earlier wording. Where the English changed, the same text is also written in the HTML element; setLanguage('english') overwrites it on load. The ▶, 💾 and ⬇ on the action buttons are added in setLanguage, as before.

## Notes

**LBL-98.** "CBDB: Look At Place" in English; the Chinese keeps the form's own name, 查看地點 / 查看地点, after "CBDB: ". The title was fixed text without "CBDB". The span got id="pageTitle", and setLanguage also sets document.title.

**LBL-99.** As on the other forms.

**LBL-100. Address filter.** Select Address becomes **Select Place** (LAP 3, 選擇地名). The small underlined "clear" link (a &lt;span&gt; with an onclick, which couldn't be reached from the keyboard) is now an **All Places** button (btnAllPlaces, class btn-clear), as on the other forms; LAP has no row for it, so the wording follows LAA 15 and LAO 16. Include Subordinate Units and Use XY References are LAP 29 and 10. **Check the width** of the two checkbox lines, which are now longer.

**LBL-101. Date filter.** The radio buttons take LAP 26–28 (No Dates, Use Index Years, Use Dynasties), replacing "No filter", "Index year range" (指數年份範圍) and "Dynasty range". The simplified labels had traditional 指數 inside simplified text (指數年份范围, 相关人物指數地点). The From / To boxes have no labels, only placeholders, which were English in every mode; they now follow the language (始年 / 終年, LAP 1, 2). The Select Dynasties button had no id and stayed in English; it is now translated (選擇朝代). The dynasty clear button read "All" (全部) through the same all key as the dynasty summary; it now has its own key and reads **All Dynasties** (LAP 24), as on Associations (LBL-57). The all key is still used for "All" in the dynasty and address-type summaries.

**LBL-102. Relation categories.** Three checkboxes take the table's wording (LAP 12, 14, 13). For the other four, the table's English (Associations, Associate, Kinship, Office Posting) is shorter and blurs what each branch matches; for example, "Associations" and "Associate" read alike, though one is the place where an association happened and the other the associate's index address. By the user's decision of 2026-10-28, those four **keep the HTML's English**, and the Chinese was rewritten to say the same thing, using terms from the table where it has them:

| Checkbox | English | Traditional | Simplified | Source of the Chinese |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| inc-biog | Individual (was Biography (BIOG_ADDR_DATA)) | 人物生平 | 人物生平 | LAP 12 |
| inc-assoc-place | Place of Association | 社會關係發生地 | 社会关系发生地 | SF_ASD 19 (Association Place) |
| inc-assoc-person | Associate's Index Place | 社會關係人指數地址 | 社会关系人指数地址 | SF_ASD 13 (社會關係人) + 指數地址 |
| inc-entry | Entry | 入仕 | 入仕 | LAP 14 (unchanged) |
| inc-kinship | Kins' Index Place | 親屬指數地址 | 亲属指数地址 | LAP 15 (親屬) + 指數地址 |
| inc-office | Office Place | 任官地址 | 任官地址 | 任官, as the Office form's postings tab (任官記錄) |
| inc-inst | Institutional (was Institution) | 社會機構 | 社会机构 | LAP 13, with 社會 by the user's decision |

指數地址 ("index address") is the term the results tables use (指數地址 headers on Kinship, Networks and this form's People tab). The earlier Chinese (相關地點, 相關人物指數地點, 親屬指數地點, 官職地點) said much the same but used 地點, 相關 and 官職, which the review has replaced elsewhere; the simplified versions also had traditional 指數. For Office Place, the Office form's Office Address heading uses the shorter 官地址; 任官地址 was preferred here because the label stands alone without a heading. The table rows LAP 15–18 are listed as not used for their English.

The address-type button, "Select Biog Addr Types", had no key and stayed in English. It now has one and reads **Select Categories** (LAP 34, 選擇地址類別; c_jianti has traditional 別, corrected). The heading Relation Types (no row) changes 類型 to 類別, the term used for Type on every form.

**LBL-103.** Run Query, Store Person IDs (regional-usage rule) and Save to … (保存于…) as on the other forms; Save to KML and Save to GIS have no LAP rows. "Export Neo4j CSVs" becomes **Save to Neo4j** (LAP 30). Export Query Results had 導出 in traditional and now has 匯出. The icons (▶, 💾, ⬇) were left as they are; no other form has them.

**LBL-104. Tabs.** LAP 31–33: **Place-People Relations** (人地關係), **Aggregated People and Places** (綜合人地關係) and People (於地址有關係的人, "people related to the place"). LAP 32 has 匯總 in c_fanti and 汇综 in c_jianti; 綜合 / 综合 is used, by the user's decision of 2026-10-28 for aggregate labels. The English tab names are longer than before; **check the tab bar**.

**Comment.** The comment above translations points to this report.

## PLC-7: Address options enabled only with a place selected

**Change.** Include Subordinate Units and Use XY References now start disabled, as does the new All Places button. handleAddressSelection enables all three when a place is picked; All Places (clearAddress()) unticks the two checkboxes and disables all three, through a new helper, setAddrOptionsEnabled(enabled). Before, the checkboxes were always enabled, and a box ticked with no place (or left ticked after clearing it) was sent with the query (includeSubUnits, addrUseXY). This matches Entry (ENT-1), Office (OFF-1) and the other forms with an address filter.

**Markup.** Unlike the other forms, Places wraps each checkbox in its label (&lt;label&gt;&lt;input type="checkbox"&gt; &lt;span&gt;…&lt;/span&gt;&lt;/label&gt;), and its stylesheet section sets those labels to display: block. The markup was left as it is; CSS-3 greys this kind of label instead.

**jsdom check.** On load both checkboxes and All Places are disabled and the labels grey (#aaa). After a place is picked all three are enabled. After ticking Use XY and clicking All Places, both checkboxes are unticked and disabled, All Places is disabled, and Run Query is disabled again.

## PLC-8: Address-type summary followed the language only in English

updateBacDisplay() wrote "All" or "N types" in English whatever the language, and setLanguage did not refresh it. It now uses the all key and a new nTypes key (" types" / 種類別 / 种类别, giving "3 types" / 3種類別), and setLanguage calls it. A single selected type still shows its description from the picker, which is in English.

## CSS-3: Wrapping checkbox labels greyed; disabled All Places button

Two additions to cbdb_styles.css:

```css

label:has(&gt; input[type="checkbox"]:disabled) { color: #aaa; cursor: default; }

.btn-clear:disabled { color: #aaa; cursor: default; }

```

The first greys a label that **contains** its disabled checkbox, which CSS-1 (input[type="checkbox"]:disabled + label) cannot reach; it uses :has(), like CSS-2, so it needs Chrome / Edge 105+, Safari 15.4+ or Firefox 121+. It applies on every page; at present only Places has disabled checkboxes inside their labels. The second gives the shared .btn-clear class (All Places, All Dynasties) a disabled look, and its hover rule now skips disabled buttons. The stylesheet delivered with this report also contains CSS-2 from the Office report.

## Issues

1. **Untranslated text.** The place-box placeholders ((none)), the address-picker labels ([All Filtered], [Multi-select]), the Aggregated tab's "Multiple" / "[Multiple]" (with fixed Chinese 多項 / [多]), and the status and error messages are English only or fixed in one language.
1. **Results-table headers.** Hard-coded and mixed, as on the other query forms (AddrName / 地名, Category, Relation / 關係, AssocName / 有關人姓名 …). The Category column shows the back end's English category names (Biography, Institution …), which don't all match the checkbox labels.
1. **Single address type.** When one address type is picked, the summary shows its English description only.
